newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Egana's ADR programme declared effective.
newsitem.headline: Egana's ADR programme declared effective.

text.p: Egana International (Holdings) Ltd said on Sunday the first phase of its American Depository Receipt Programme (ADR) had been declared effective as of October 30 by the Securities and Exchange Commission of the U.S.

Egana, a manufacturer and distributor of watches and jewellery, said in a statement trading of the ADRs would start on the over-the-counter market in the U.S. as soon as possible with the Bank of New York acting as the depositary for the ADR programme.
Each American Depository share represents 50 deposited ordinary shares of the company, Egana said.
